description:
REAR GARDEN		
T1	Weeping Beech (Fagus sylvatica varpendula)	Crown lift by up to 2m all round to tidy and give some clearance from surrounding trees and structures. Remove protruding/overextended branches from the top of the tree. Final height = 8m and final spread = 6m.

T2	Ash (Fraxinus excelsior)	Crown reduce by approximately 2m back to most recent previous reduction points. Final height = 6m and final spread = 4m.	

T3	Ash (Fraxinus excelsior)	Crown reduce by approximately 2m back to most recent previous reduction points. Final height = 8m and final spread = 5m.	

T4	Crimson King (Acer platanoides Crimson King)	Crown reduce by approximately 2m back to most recent previous reduction points.
         Final height = 8m and final spread = 6m.	

FRONT GARDEN		

T7	Crab Apple (Malus sylvestris)	20% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 1-2m to tidy and contain, retaining furnishing growth. Final height = 4m and final spread = 2m.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
